text: Public IG reply: Same — I wishlist every reel outfit then wait for sale. Rarely purchase. Price sensitivity + endless scrolling = full wishlist, empty cart.
Instagram comment on haul post: Looks cute but I'm unsure about fit on different body types. Shortlisted similar pieces, still hesitating to buy without try-on.
Public thread: Online fashion shopping tip — treat wishlist as research. Compare on other apps, read reviews, ask friends. That extra searching delays purchase by design.
Saw this in a shopping reel comments: Fabric quality looks off in daylight photos. Keeping it wishlisted until more honest reviews appear. Trust issues.
Fashion shopping group post: Saved festive wear for Diwali. Will purchase closer to the occasion. Timing and styling uncertainty keep me from buying now.
Public comment: Stopped converting wishlist items after a painful return. Now I bookmark passively and prefer trying in-store when possible.
Poll replies: Most people use fashion app wishlists as moodboards not checkout queues. Passive bookmarking dominates over genuine purchase intent.
Can't decide between two shortlisted co-ords. Styling looks different on influencers. Asking friends on Stories before I purchase — still not sure.
Group tip: If size goes OOS on your wishlist, set alerts. I lost two active shortlist buys to stockouts after waiting for salary week.
Before buying from wishlist I search the product on Google and YouTube. In-app reviews alone aren't enough. Outside validation slows me down.
Public conversation about online fashion shopping: Users delay wishlist purchases for coupons, fit confirmation, and delivery promises. Non-conversion is rarely one single reason.
Wishlist updated during salary week browsing. Will wait for a better offer. Budget shopping means postponed purchase even when I love the item.
